name: comp-238
title: Multi-Select Listbox
description: A listbox for selecting multiple items built on React Aria. Supports keyboard navigation and shows all selected items at once.
use_when: Users need to select multiple related items from a visible list.
avoid_when: Single selection or when search is needed for large lists.
a11y: Full keyboard support; multi-select via Shift+Click or Ctrl+Click; aria-label.
